title: A host-raised named-root end blocks all naming on its claim, and this build has nothing that sends it
outcome: A pending root_invalid or session_gone_at_restore end on a live claim is sent by a production path, so naming on that claim can finish without a restart, and an end that truly remains unsettled still can't be overtaken.
acceptance: The sequence is reproduced by a deterministic test on the unchanged product: a host-raised end pending on a live claim, then naming and clearing on that claim
After the fix a production path sends that end, naming on the claim then finishes, and a failed send leaves it pending
